scenario.name: Managed initial subscription with early NOTIFY and final notification
scenario.send:
NOTIFY [rsip_uri] SIP/2.0 Via: SIP/2.0/[transport] [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=z9hG4bK-early-notify-[pid] From: <[sipp_uri]>;tag=sipp-subscription To: <[rsip_uri]>;tag=[$from_tag] [$call_id] CSeq: 1 NOTIFY Max-Forwards: 70 Event: presence Subscription-State: active;expires=60 Contact: <[sipp_uri]> Content-Type: application/pidf+xml Content-Length: [len]
<presence><tuple><status><basic>open</basic></status></tuple></presence>

NOTIFY [rsip_uri] SIP/2.0 Via: SIP/2.0/[transport] [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=z9hG4bK-refresh-notify-[pid] From: <[sipp_uri]>;tag=sipp-subscription To: <[rsip_uri]>;tag=[$from_tag] [$call_id] CSeq: 2 NOTIFY Max-Forwards: 70 Event: presence Subscription-State: active;expires=30 Contact: <[sipp_uri]> Content-Length: 0

NOTIFY [rsip_uri] SIP/2.0 Via: SIP/2.0/[transport] [local_ip]:[local_port];branch=z9hG4bK-final-notify-[pid] From: <[sipp_uri]>;tag=sipp-subscription To: <[rsip_uri]>;tag=[$from_tag] [$call_id] CSeq: 3 NOTIFY Max-Forwards: 70 Event: presence Subscription-State: terminated;reason=timeout Contact: <[sipp_uri]> Content-Length: 0
